verses.text: 14. Someone else asked him, ‘Is one righteous man enough to appease God?’ He replied, ‘Yes, for he himself has written: “Find a man who lives according to righteousness, and I will pardon the whole people.” ’ (Jer. 5.1)
2. He also said, ’Fasting is a check against sin for the monk. He who discards it is like a rampaging stallion.’ (cf. Jer. 5.8)
